fact.label: BA completion in SES quartile group 4

fact.label: Upper minus lower SES quartile-group BA completion rate
fact.method: 100 times recomputed upper-group BA proportion minus lower-group proportion. This qualifies the prior tail-gap statistic by using mutually exclusive quartile intervals: the upper group uses SES > the 75th percentile, whereas the prior statistic used >=. It is a related descriptive contrast, not an exact replication or an adjusted effect.
fact.population: Eligible lower group n=2194 and upper group n=2192
